author: Shoddy Language contributors
name: Shoddy console consumer
description: A console program consuming a Shoddy mill as an ordinary .NET reference: ShoddyWeave builds the mill, Shoddy.Hosting calls its words, and F5 debugs the Shoddy alongside the C#.

mill.description: Path to the mill folder (holding mill.manifest), relative to the new project.

grant.description: Semicolon-separated capability grants matching the mill's manifest (default-deny: an ungranted required capability refuses the build, printing the exact line to fix).

shoddyBuild.description: Path to Shoddy.Build's build/ folder (or leave for the packaged import once published).
